recipes.name: Sticky Toffee Coffee Cake
ingredients: 6 oz Medjool date, pitted & roughly chopped
2 3/4 oz unsalted butter, cubed and room temperature
instructions: For the Date Filling

Combine the dates, water, and brown sugar in a small saucepot. Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 8-12 minutes or until the dates are completely tender. - 6 oz Medjool date pitted & roughly chopped - 6 oz water - 1 ½ tbsp brown sugar
Turn off the heat and let the mixture cool for 10-15 minutes.

Transfer the date mixture to a food processor or blender and process until smooth. Alternatively, blend the mixture until smooth using an immersion blender. - 6 oz Medjool date pitted & roughly chopped - 6 oz water - 1 ½ tbsp brown sugar
Transfer the filling to a bowl and stir in the cinnamon and salt. Set aside until ready to use. - ¼ tsp kosher salt - For the Date Filling - 1 tsp ground cinnamon
For the Streusel Topping

Combine the flour, sugar, cinnamon, salt, and baking powder in a medium bowl. Whisk to thoroughly combine. - 6 oz all purpose flour - 5 ½ oz dark brown sugar - ½ tbsp ground cinnamon - ¼ tsp kosher salt - ⅛ tsp baking powder

Add the room temperature butter to the bowl, then fold the mixture together using a fork. Once mostly combined, squeeze the mixture by hand to form clumps. Set aside in the refrigerator until ready to use. - 2 ¾ oz unsalted butter cubed and room temperature
For the Toffee Glaze

Combine the heavy cream, sugar, and butter in a small saucepan. Bring to a simmer and cook over medium-low heat until the sauce is deepened in colors and thickened, about 7-12 minutes. - 4 ½ oz heavy cream - 4 oz light brown sugar - 1 ½ oz unsalted butter cubed

Let cool to room temperature before using. If the sauce becomes grainy and split, add more heavy cream, about 1 tablespoon at a time, while whisking until a smooth sauce-like consistency returns. - 4 ½ oz heavy cream - For the Toffee Glaze
For the Cake
Preheat the oven to 350 °F. Prepare a 9-inch x 5-inch loaf pan with nonstick spray and parchment paper, making sure to leave 2-3 inches of extra parchment on the sides to act as leaves.
Combine the flour, baking powder, baking soda, and salt in a medium bowl. Whisk to combine and set aside. - 8 ½ oz cake flour - 1 ½ tsp baking powder - 1 tsp baking soda - 1 tsp kosher salt

In another bowl, whisk together the eggs, sour cream, treacle (or molasses), and vanilla extract. Set aside until ready to use. - 2 large eggs room temperature - 8 ½ oz sour cream room temperature - 1 tbsp black treacle or molasses - 2 tsp vanilla paste

In the bowl of a stand mixer, combine the butter, brown sugar, and granulated sugar. Using the paddle attachment, cream the butter and sugar together until lightened in color and fluffy, about 3-4 minutes. - 4 oz unsalted butter room temperature - 4 oz dark brown sugar - 2 oz granulated sugar

Scrape down the sides of the bowl using a plastic spatula. Then, add the egg mixture to the bowl. Mix until well combined. - 2 large eggs room temperature - 8 ½ oz sour cream room temperature - 1 tbsp black treacle or molasses - 2 tsp vanilla paste

Add all of the dry ingredients at once to the bowl and mix until just combined. - 8 ½ oz cake flour - 1 ½ tsp baking powder - 1 tsp baking soda - 1 tsp kosher salt - 4 oz dark brown sugar - 2 oz granulated sugar
Transfer half of the batter to the prepared loaf pan. - For the Cake

Then spread the Date Filling over the batter using a mini offset spatula or a spoon. Add the other half of batter over the filling and spread until relatively smooth. - Date Filling (see recipe below) - For the Date Filling - For the Cake

Sprinkle the Streusel Topping over top until the surface of the batter is completely covered. If there is leftover streusel topping, freeze in a sealable bag for up to up to 6 months. - Streusel Topping (see recipe below)
Bake the cake in the preheated oven for 65 - 75 minutes or until cooked through (~200°F internal temperature). Let cool completely before lifting out of the baking pan. - For the Cake
Once cool, drizzle with Toffee Glaze and optionally, serve with whipped cream. - Toffee Glaze (see recipe below) - Optional: whipped cream - For the Cake
